a_before_b.rationale: Understanding how to use public benchmarks and leaderboards is not required to explain why comparative rankings do not reveal absolute performance or why a model win does not guarantee a worthwhile swap.

b_before_a.rationale: A learner must understand that comparative rankings do not reveal absolute performance and that a win does not guarantee a worthwhile swap before they can meaningfully use benchmarks to filter out bad models while recognizing their limitations.
